design_disclosure.interpretation: The legacy values exposed histogram quantization. They may be used to design and regression-test this protocol, but they cannot be retroactively promoted to PASS.

fixed_inputs.histogram_bucket_semantics: non-cumulative counts keyed by strictly increasing upper_bound_us

statistics.n_definition: n is the common fresh query_count; each run's complete histogram count must also equal n
statistics.tail_count_definition: T_i(b) = sum of run i histogram counts whose upper_bound_us is > b
statistics.all_derived_values_source: n, rank, tail_budget, sigma, and both count budgets are derived from the fresh equal query_count; no fixed-n budget is permitted
statistics.statistical_claim_limit: The three-sigma budget is a frozen operational admission budget, not a confidence interval or a claim that query latencies are independent Bernoulli samples.

lower_fixed_boundary.count_definition: T_i(150000) = sum of complete histogram counts whose upper_bound_us is > 150000

upper_fixed_boundary.count_definition: T_i(250000) = sum of complete histogram counts whose upper_bound_us is > 250000

overall_decision.pass_definition: PASS iff correctness, clean-window, process-run, resource, QPS CV <= 0.07, mean storage latency CV <= 0.07, both fixed-boundary per-run count limits, both fixed-boundary cross-run range limits, and zero-overflow gates all pass. P99 upper-bound CV is diagnostic_only and never participates in state.
overall_decision.hold_definition: Any failed, missing, malformed, non-finite, provenance-mismatched, or unverifiable hard-gate input yields HOLD.
overall_decision.lease_rule: A batch lease may be issued only from a fresh PASS under this exact protocol and a fully bound candidate commit/tree/config.

fail_closed_conditions: missing or incomplete raw histogram counts
histogram counts do not sum to query_count
histogram bounds differ across runs
histogram_boundary_sha256 differs across runs
reported P99 does not exactly recompute from the histogram
any overflow count is nonzero
any run's count above 150000 us exceeds n - rank + ceil(3 * sigma)
any run's count above 250000 us exceeds n - rank
the cross-run count range above either 150000 us or 250000 us exceeds ceil(3 * sqrt(2) * sigma)
query counts differ across runs
QPS CV exceeds 0.07
mean storage latency CV exceeds 0.07
gate_contract is missing, malformed, or does not bind the exact frozen policy and stability result
a bound tool file reference or SHA-256 is missing or drifts
run metrics bench_json path or SHA-256 does not bind the exact P31 command stdout evidence
run metrics does not exactly recompute from P31 command stdout using the frozen query plan and protocol parameters
result/repeat identities or metrics/P31 paths are not canonical children of the current fresh run root
P31 manifest validation differs from validation.json or either contains errors or warnings
any P31 run is not DONE and PASS
any legacy repeat is mixed into the fresh confirmation batch
